case.name: index_order_after_update
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT unicode(substr(CAST(t.payload AS TEXT),-1,1)) AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t WHERE t.grp<1024 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.id=t.seq AND u.v>=t.v) ORDER BY t.grp DESC,t.v DESC,t.id LIMIT 16384);
case.prepare: UPDATE t SET v=v+1 WHERE seq%2=0;
